g.text: Granite + Jev on 300 synthetic logic worlds
Three seeds per world; 900 planned jobs per arm. Failed jobs count as incorrect.
All arms share a final-label grammar. Timing includes hosted Jev and discarded lookaheads;
model loading and between-job recovery are excluded from these per-job means.
